intro: The wall above the home court doesn't lie: retired numbers, graduated captains and the few players who genuinely changed this club. Inducted by the committee each homecoming.

retiredJerseys.name: Avery Rivera
retiredJerseys.note: First All-American in club history — 1,842 career points.

retiredJerseys.name: Daniel Okafor
retiredJerseys.note: Two conference titles and finals MVP in 2022.

retiredJerseys.name: Noah Bennett
retiredJerseys.note: All-time blocks leader, captain for three seasons.

inductees.name: Avery Rivera
inductees.impact: Turned a mid-table club into a conference contender. 1,842 points and 612 assists, both club records.
inductees.quote: The ball finds the right people when you play for each other.

inductees.name: Daniel Okafor
inductees.impact: Two-time conference champion, 2022 finals MVP and still the standard for a two-way guard at this club.
inductees.quote: Nobody remembers the shot; they remember the squad.

inductees.name: Noah Bennett
inductees.impact: All-time leader in blocks and rebounds, and captain for three of his four seasons.
inductees.quote: Defence is a promise you keep every night.

inductees.name: Isaiah Brooks
inductees.impact: Holds the club record for career three-pointers (825) and single-game threes (11).
inductees.quote: Repetition is the only shortcut I ever found.

inductees.name: Maya Sinclair
inductees.impact: Built the women's squad's first travel-league season and led the club in assists for four years.
inductees.quote: We built the room we wished we had walked into.

inductees.name: Elena Rossi
inductees.impact: Ten seasons of fixtures, travel and fundraising — the reason the club still runs the way it does.
inductees.quote: Clubs are run by the people who show up on the boring days.
